about: The falsifier: a demand whose condition had no FACT refused its whole batch, so under the one act no demand could stand owed from its birth.

cases.name: lane C at 228: verify/gate/rebirth, condition gate/rebirth/verify
cases.said: REFUSE take verify/gate/rebirth · it rests on gate/rebirth/verify, which has no FACT · a batch lands whole or not at all
